w6_protocol_self_application.rationale: T-IR-039 v0.1 codifies the W6 protocol. The W6 protocol requires EVERY SHIPPED spec to have a sidecar. Therefore T-IR-039 v0.1 must have a sidecar (this file). Furthermore, T-IR-039 v0.1 is INTENDED to demonstrate that W6 is self-applying — the protocol works on its own codifying spec, which is the strongest possible proof-of-concept.
w6_protocol_self_application.future_self_drift_handling: If T-IR-039 v0.1 is modified post-SHIP (e.g., new Codif 7 v0.2 events added, Codif 30 v0.4 sub-class 5 expanded), the W6 protocol triggers a mechanical bump v0.1 → v0.1.1 (per Codif 22 v0.2). The v0.1 file is DELETED, v0.1.1 file is created, v0.1.1 sidecar is created (Codif 9 v0.2 EXTENSION PROPOSAL #2 instantiation #5), and the v0.1 sidecar (this file) is archived in the v0.1.1 sidecar's w4_filesystem_stat_v01_archived field.
